**Program:** MSDM Culminating Experience Project, Cal Poly Pomona (Fall 2026 to Summer 2027)\
**Client:** Collins College of Hospitality Management\
**Team:** Four person group; I lead Analytics Objective 3

## My objective

Identify where the college loses prospective students between application and enrollment, and which factors most influence the decision to enroll, using admissions data and a survey of current students.

## Approach so far

- Grounded the work in college choice research, including Hossler and Gallagher's stage model and Chapman's model of influences on college choice
- Drafted survey constructs covering significant persons, program and university characteristics, understanding of cost and aid, and outreach before enrollment
- Built the dashboard structure on this site so it's ready when the client data arrives
